title: 第320章 番外人外有人第319章 番外环环相扣
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
“要的就是他们浑身抽搐。”
“金阳牛和碧水蛇，我都打算放一整个妖王族群。”
“可是碧水蛇也不是好惹的，他们拿不到水凝果怎么办。”
八卦盘虽然闹腾了点，但本质上还是很善良的。
一时间，她有些为那些年轻人们担忧了。
“这好办，在水潭之外，再起一片湖泊，里面就养鳐鱼，碧水蛇最喜欢吃鳐鱼了，钓鱼就能拿到水凝果了。”
李君器淡然一笑，随意说着。
“那他们为什么不直接吃鳐鱼？”
“吃鳐鱼就没房子住。”
李君器对于坑人那可太有耐心了，计划一环扣一环。
八卦盘这下子服了，君器真是给皇子公主们安排的明明白白。
这一手是真狠。
原因也简单，观山望海虽然可以吸纳灵气，从而保持不用进食。
但无论是钓鳐鱼，还是开挖金阳铁，亦或者砍阴华铁树，还有后续的屋子搭建，家具制造，都需要耗费大量灵气。
尤其是这阴华铁树，本身就会大量吸取灵气。
就像某些作物，会大量吸收土壤肥沃度一样。
虽然硬，但却并非打造兵器的好材料。
一些实力不够的铁匠，用阴华铁树打造武器，打着打着被这玩意吸死的不在少数。
君器这一手，让皇子公主们再能吸收灵气，该饿还得饿。
不过，八卦盘忽然想到一个问题。

“但是他们有修为，完全可以睡外......”
八卦盘话还没说完，李君器就自顾自继续说了下去。
“因此，这个空间内的昼夜温差也得足够大才行。”
“要不然他们凭借着武道修为，以天为被，以地为席，直接偷懒怎么办？”
“所以秘境内四季变化需要剧烈。”
“一天一变，今天早上是盛夏，那晚上就是风雪。”
“寒灯佛庙的功法用来充当雪夜就很不错。”
“而早上是暖春，那么晚上必定春雨搭配春雷。”
“早上是秋天，那么晚上就秋风萧瑟，侵蚀肌肤神识。”
“早上是冬天，晚上就酷热难耐。”
“反之亦然，总之季节变化不定。”
“天冷就要金阳铁打造的家具来取暖，或者直接砍雷云羊领地的雷击木来烧火取暖。”
“这样一来，就必须有个家，否则在外面必定遭老罪。”
李君器越说越兴奋，眼底都亮起了光芒。
“还是你狠啊。”
八卦盘听到最后，心服口服了。
可以说，李君器已经把大部分漏洞给补上了。
“来，我们继续完善一下。”
“同时秘境里可以放灵晶留影，让其他人观看皇子公主们的历练生涯。”
李君器越想，越觉得有说法。

他打算把武媚杨璎也给整进去。
content_en:
"All you want is for them to twitch all over."
"I plan to release the entire demon king group from both the Golden Sun Ox and the Green Water Snake."
"But the green water snakes are not easy to mess with. What if they can't get the water congealed fruit?"
Although Bagua Pan is a bit noisy, he is still very kind in nature.
For a moment, she was worried about those young people.
"This is easy to do. There is a lake outside the pool, and there are rays in it. The green water snake likes to eat rays the most. If you fish, you can get the water condensate fruit."
Li Junqi smiled lightly and spoke casually.
"Then why don't they just eat the rays?"
"If you eat rays, you won't have a house to live in."
Li Junqi is very patient when it comes to tricking people, and he plans to do it one step at a time.
I'm convinced by the Baguapan now. The emperor's weapons are clearly arranged for the princes and princesses.
This hand is really cruel.
The reason is also simple. Although looking at the mountains and sea can absorb spiritual energy, there is no need to eat.
But whether it's fishing for rays, digging for Golden Yang Iron, or cutting down Yinhua Iron trees, as well as subsequent house construction and furniture manufacturing, a lot of spiritual energy is consumed.
Especially the Yinhua Iron Tree, which itself absorbs a large amount of spiritual energy.
Just like some crops, they absorb a lot of soil fertility.
Although it is hard, it is not a good material for making weapons.
Some blacksmiths who were not strong enough used Yinhua Iron Tree to make weapons, and many of them were sucked to death by this weapon.
Junqi's hand allows the princes and princesses to absorb spiritual energy no matter how hungry they should be.
However, Baguapan suddenly thought of a question.
"But they have cultivation and can sleep outside..."
Before he finished talking about the gossip, Li Junqi continued talking on his own.
"Therefore, the temperature difference between day and night in this space must be large enough."
"What if they rely on their martial arts skills, use the sky as a blanket, and the earth as a mat, and just be lazy?"
"So the changes in the four seasons in the secret area need to be dramatic."
"One day changes. This morning it was midsummer, and that night it was wind and snow."
"The techniques of the Handeng Buddhist Temple are very good for use as a snowy night."
"And if it's warm spring in the morning, then there will be spring rain and spring thunder in the evening."
"It's autumn in the morning, and the autumn wind is bleak at night, eroding the skin and consciousness."
“It’s winter in the morning, and it’s sweltering hot at night.”
"And vice versa, the seasons change."
"When it's cold, you can use furniture made of Jinyang Iron to keep warm, or you can just cut down the lightning-struck wood from the Thunder Cloud Sheep's territory to make a fire to keep warm."
"In this case, you must have a home, otherwise you will suffer the same fate outside."
Li Junqi became more and more excited as he talked, and his eyes lit up.
"You are still ruthless."
Bagua Pan was convinced after hearing the end.
It can be said that Li Junqi has filled most of the loopholes.
"Come on, let's continue to improve it."
"At the same time, spiritual crystals can be placed in the secret realm to take photos, so that others can watch the training career of the princes and princesses."
The more Li Junqi thought about it, the more he felt he had an explanation.
He planned to get Wu Mei and Yang Ying involved.
